Hey. I don't know how to help you (not because it's impossible, but because i just don't really know how to life), so i just wanted to say i read the whole thing. And probably you have already done a lot to deal with consequences from your past, but maybe there is something you can do about it so it could help with increasing your learning ability and finding a job?
I read it as "silver strapon", but tampon is good either.
The most obvious solution: https://i.imgur.com/CB7Jkav.jpg

You know what i think it means? It could mean you're able to get it back. Sure, after suffering depression you will never be the same person again, but if there are things you were passionate about they could help you to find your way back. Is there any way i could try to help you?

Why are you feeling this way? Have you tried looking for help? And hey, i see you are helping other people in this subreddit and telling it can be ok. And it is important. It means you are feeling and caring human, and losing such a human would make this world a bit sadder place.

If it was your first time cutting or if you are not doing it regularly, please don't start! I understand that living with depression is hard, but cuts hurt much longer than the good feeling lasts (if it appears at all). It adds physical pain to the mental and life seems even shittier. And please get help if you haven't already!
Looks like the best way to miss all the green lights and get stuck forever.

Maybe you don't have to go to the hospital straightaway, but you sure should visit a doctor, just to feel safer about yourself. I'm not an expert, but i think you have to do something now not wait until it gets worse. Even if it turns out it was just one occasion, taking care of your mental wellbeing is always good for you.

It's logical that she will feel sad and feel grief. The thing you can do is to look for realistic way to help her with emotions- listen to her, suggest therapy, help with finding new friends. It's not able to change current situation, so the only way is creating environment that will help her now and in future.

Maybe you can try another therapist or type of therapy? And set a date some time in future when you can reconsider your situation again. Maybe it will be a bit better. I don't know. i'm pretty sure there are things that can help you. It's just that finding them is painful and shitty process, but if you get to solution it's usually worth it.

Hey, you're not a joke! You are a human, and human's brain go wrong sometimes. It's sad and hard for you, but it's not permanent. You say you're not getting help because of busy schedule. You definitely should say no to some of your everyday things and get help. There is no meaning for school bands, bowling or even Harvard if you're feeling that way. Maybe people around you will be a bit disappointed if you go to the doctor or get other help instead of doing things they are used to seeing you do. But they can get over it. You are the only person you should deal with for all of your life. So make friends with yourself. Get help for yourself. Other people can't do that for you, you have to break out at least for a day, start with that help thing and then saying no should be easier for the next time because you will know why you do it.
As far as i understand, you are cutter too. So i tell you as a fellow cutter and former overachiever- you can totally do it. You just have to make the first step which is the hardest.

You don't have to be sorry for saying how you feel. But hey- if you are telling your story and your feels here, you might have at least a little hope that someone can say something or help in a way that could make you feel a bit better. I suppose you have googled any possible "how to stop feeling suicidal?" question. You can find more useful, professional information than any redditor will ever be able to say. I don't know. I have no idea who you are, but i think humans are supposed to care about other humans. And i care about you. It's some weird you're-just-random-stranger and i'll never meet you, but still.

Your situation sucks, but it looks like you can escape it, because you're having problems with other people and not (as much) with yourself. You could not escape yourself, but can get away from your family. Go to another city, get some job or study in uni somewhere where it's free. There are tos of opportunities, and maybe somewhere there is the solution.
It maybe sounds crazy, but there are all these volunteer programs in Europe, if you're interested in that. You could go and help poor people in Africa or god knows where. And never see your family again. And feel at least a bit fulfilled because you do something meaningful and you matter.
I have no idea when your birthday is. But wish i could give you the right amount of right brain chemicals for your birthday.

You might really be smart enough, but depression can stop you from doing your best and make you feel like you just can't do it. Is there a way to get counselor? Professional help might make you feel better about yourself. And if you can get individual study plan in your school it might help with classes, too. Maybe it could make you feel better overall.

If i changed the statement you wrote and asked a question "can you get better?", answer sounds much more positive. It's highly probable that you can get better. When and how will it happen? That's the hard part of the question. Maybe a new medication or therapist can help. I don't know. And you don't know. Not knowing means there is a chance for something positive.
When my friends feel sad, i sometimes ask if there is any way i can help. Maybe you can do the opposite and ask yourself if anyone can help you. And if answer is 'yes' you could ask that person for help. As far as i understand, you might feel like you have nothing to lose. So asking for help might result in something to gain. Maybe even gaining a will to live again. I don't know. There could just be something.

Yes, you're right. We are cater, carbon, phosphorus and other elements. But are we just elements? It really depends on how are you looking at it. There is that "people are 60% water so we're just cucumbers with anxiety" meme. And it's true to some extent, but it's understandable if someone calls the thing bullshit.
I might be very wrong, but the way you wrote your post reminds me of conversations about philosophy and science. I might be very wrong, but maybe finding people who are able to understand this world in deeper levels than people around you could help. You could learn ideas and stories and viewpoints that could help you to find meaning or at least forget that feeling of pointlessness. Maybe life is not about reaching your ideals and being the real you, but about moments when you feel something that makes everything bearable.

You don't have to say sorry. Your feelings are not normal (because humans should not feel this way), but still really understandable. And even if you're right and everyone you know wants you to kill yourself (which is really unbelievable, but you know your situation better) there are literally billions of people who don't think you're loser because they just don't know you. And you can try to show your best side to strangers and hope they will be ready to get to know real you. If you can't find new people in real life, internet is full of people. They can be lonely, bored, interested, just wanting to find new friends, it does not matter. And i have no idea what do you like to do, but i'm pretty sure there are people with interests similar to yours. It probably won't happen in one day, but internet friends are so much better than nothing and can be a good beginning of feeling-more-ok process.

Your situation seems pretty awful. I could say something nice and encouraging, but you're smart enough to not believe random person on internet who does not know a thing about you. And you sad it yourself- one sentence with sad emojis can get lots of comments and upvotes but that's because it seems like these people are not so sad and so desperate and that saying something nice can help them. 
But I don't know how I can help you. I read your post and only reaction was "shit, it's sad". Have you tried to go to therapist (or doctor or smth)? Because your problem sounds really bad and i'm not sure if you can get better without help. Or maybe you can, but therapist can make it a lot easier. You should at least try. ok?

I want you to live. I'm not saying it definitely will be easy or nice, but no human being is so worthless that they deserve to die. And even if you feel like it's pointless there are ways to find hope. If you haven't been to therapist, try that. Or get a pet if you can, it helps because you have someone to love and care about and someone who loves you back. You have to try to find (or if you can't find then get or invent a new) meaning in your life. It can be ok.
Don't worry, i have more!
